statement: The Figure 5 legend contains an n = 20 with no stated unit, while mice are 5 per group.

The loss-of-function evidence has 'n = 2 replications of the results' (Figure 9 legend) in one cone-photoreceptor cell line (661W), with siRNA from one supplier (Ambion) at 5 and 25 pmol against a scrambled control, and the legend does not say that the two replications are separate experiments.
The rat GFAP and Iba1 densities are the mean of three independent experiments, each with at least three affected and three normal males; the number of animals per plotted point is not stated.
